newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel share group protests debt plan.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel share group protests debt plan.

text.p: The chairman of Adacte, a French Eurotunnel shareholders association, said on Thursday he had lodged a lawsuit with the president of the Paris commercial court to block the company's debt restructuring agreement.
"This morning, Adacte lodged a lawsuit with (court president) Mr Mattei," Albert Jauffret told Reuters. "We object on principle to the absence of a debt write-off."
An official in Mattei's office confirmed it had received Adacte's suit. Mattei was not available for comment.
Eurotunnel has agreed with negotiating banks a refinancing of its 70 billion francs ($13.5 billion) of debt and unpaid interest.
Jauffret had not seen the details of the refinancing deal but said the "absence of a debt write-off was a declaration of war against the shareholders".
The debt restructuring needs approval of Eurotunnel's board, 24 instructing banks and eventually a qualified, two thirds majority of shareholders.
Eventually, all of its 225 lending banks must accept the deal.
